findings.summary: core-golden-flight emits git.commit under adapterId 'git' with payload {filesChanged, insertions, deletions}, but the git-history collector and dx.git.* metrics use adapterId 'git-history' and {linesAdded, linesDeleted, sha, numstatAvailable}. Against the canonical golden fixture, dx.git.commits is unavailable although fixture expectations say commitCount 2. C07 covers commits via its own c07-branch-extras fixture shaped like the real collector.

When two appended batches carry coverage for the same adapterId (e.g. cursor-usage-csv complete in one batch, none in another), snapshot coverage is last-append-wins. Reversed append order gives the same snapshotId but different coverage, so the same snapshotId can yield different metrics. snapshotId should cover coverage or coverage merging should be order-independent. C07 avoids the conflict in its golden input; not fixed here.
